description: In the mirror above the checkout counter of the hat shop, the Cheshire Cat fades into view, grins, and fades away again.

whereToLook.scene: Inside the Mad Hatter shop, the mirror above the checkout counter
whereToLook.exactSpot: Watch the mirror for a few seconds. The cat appears and disappears on a loop.

bestTip: Stand to the side of the register so you are not in the way, and give it a minute.

viewing.notes: On a loop; wait for the cycle.
